'''Massassi trees''' were [[Color/Legends|purple]]-barked [[Tree/Legends|trees]] native to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. The trees featured huge crowns and upsweeping branches and were capable of reaching 200 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height. [[Nebula orchid]]s and ferns climbed on them. The thick mulch from their bark and leaves nourished [[blueleaf]] shrubs.

The tree received its name because it was the most common [[Species/Legends|species]] around the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] temple ruins.<ref name="GG2" />
